tasks.label: build-ros2
tasks.command: docker exec ros2-humble bash -c "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && cd /root/ros2_ws && colcon build --symlink-install"
tasks.detail: 编译 ROS2 工作空间

tasks.label: run-talker
tasks.command: docker exec -it ros2-humble bash -c "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source /root/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 run example_pkg talker"
tasks.detail: 运行 Talker 发布者节点

tasks.label: run-listener
tasks.command: docker exec -it ros2-humble bash -c "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source /root/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 run example_pkg listener"
tasks.detail: 运行 Listener 订阅者节点

tasks.label: run-rviz2
tasks.command: xhost +local:docker && docker exec ros2-humble bash -c "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && rviz2"
tasks.detail: 启动 RViz2 可视化工具

tasks.label: run-rqt
tasks.command: xhost +local:docker && docker exec ros2-humble bash -c "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && rqt"
tasks.detail: 启动 rqt 图形化工具

tasks.label: run-gazebo
tasks.command: xhost +local:docker && docker exec ros2-humble bash -c "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && gazebo"
